verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply; key build-outs behind schedule are being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 90 leads at a blended cost per lead of $20.14, but the final week of the period showed a 37.5% drop in leads week-over-week and a 61% spike in cost per lead — a real structural decline, not statistical noise. The primary driver is a sharp fall in Google Business Profile engagement, down 41.8% week-over-week, with the Weston location generating calls at a rate roughly 20 times below your best-performing location despite strong impressions. Separately, several program build-outs — including dedicated landing pages, conversion tracking, and local search campaigns — that were scheduled for completion months ago are still outstanding, which limits both performance and our ability to measure it fully. Work to correct the Weston profile, complete the outstanding deliverables, and restore pipeline visibility is underway now. Next period you should see improved call volume from Weston and cleaner conversion data as tracking is brought online.

watch_item.issue: The Weston location's call rate is critically low — 20 calls from 1,436 impressions this period — and is pulling down overall engagement across all profiles.
watch_item.fix: A Google Business Profile audit for Weston is in progress now to identify and resolve what is suppressing calls.
